title: An honest ending gives growth room

captions.physics: Ending an exhausted form of help

meaning: Your care can give growth room when an honest measure of involvement allows unnecessary help to end without dismissing a person.
text: Acceptance can become more tangible after an extra obligation ends. In the physical position of Anahata, Death expresses care through ending an exhausted form of help and moving towards other involvement. Justice in energy brings a wish to consider decisions’ consequences for both people and preserve an honest measure. The Empress in emotions offers generous warmth and room for growth. Tenderness may come from independence not costing attention. Support changes shape without requiring convenience or proof of an earlier contribution’s value through continually needing the same service from the other person.

For example, one person has long redone the finishing of the other’s crafts at home, considering this help. You end that arrangement and leave materials accessible for individual trials. **An end to correction can free room for warm acceptance.** A new object turns out differently and can stay on the shared shelf without compulsory reworking. Care remains in honestly named involvement and experience available on request without compulsory submission to the more skilled person.

A wish for honest limits can make an ending abrupt: managing alone is now required. Spaciousness becomes loneliness before a task. Alternatively, generosity takes the whole process over again without noticing an individual wish. Warmth preserves a clear, available response. An unnecessary method can end while presence remains, without expecting immediate mastery, continual gratitude or identical feelings about every object made.
